title: A Deal Is Done
summary:
OPEC and non-OPEC reach an agreement to cut output in 2019
It is December and another OPEC production cut is around the corner. The latest reports from Vienna indicate that the delegates of OPEC and non-OPEC reached an agreement to cut a combined 1.2 million barrels per day (b/d), with OPEC cutting 800,000 b/d and non-OPEC 400,000 b/d. Iran seems to be exempt from making cuts.
